entities.summary: Belomorsk is a town and the administrative center of Belomorsky District in the Republic of Karelia, Russia, located on the Onega Bay on the shore of the White Sea. Population: 11,217 (2010 census); 13,103 (2002 census); 18,935 (1989 Soviet census).
